words.def: as soon as you can — a polite way to ask for something quickly.
words.book: I'd like to request a ___ with you to discuss ___ at your earliest convenience.
uses: Email
Please return the signed contract at your earliest convenience.
Chat
call me at your earliest convenience 🙏
Meeting
Could you share the site drawings at your earliest convenience?
dont: Please answer me in the nearest time.
doo: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

words.def: another possible choice instead of the first one.
words.book: Please let me know which option works best for you, or suggest an alternative date and time.
uses: Email
If Sunday doesn't work, please suggest an alternative date for the site visit.
Chat
that model is out of stock — any alternative?
Meeting
The 10 kVA isn't available, but we can offer an alternative from another brand.
doo: Could you suggest an alternative date?

words.def: to improve the quality or value of something.
words.book: Your input is invaluable in helping us enhance our ___ and serve you better.
uses: Email
We've added remote monitoring to enhance our service contracts.
Chat
new dashboard really enhances the customer experience 👌
Meeting
Upgrading the batteries will enhance backup time by 30%.
dont: We want to make our service more better.
doo: We want to enhance our service.

words.def: not yet paid or not yet done.
words.book: Here are the details of the outstanding invoice: invoice number, invoice date, due date, amount due.
uses: Email
Please find attached a statement of all outstanding invoices.
Chat
we still have 3 outstanding invoices from them
Meeting
The outstanding balance is EGP 450,000 — mostly from Q2.
dont: There is invoices still not paying.
doo: There are still some outstanding invoices.

words.def: the date by which a payment or task must be completed.
words.book: Here are the details of the outstanding invoice: invoice number, invoice date, due date, amount due.
uses: Email
Invoice 1045 passed its due date on 30 June.
Chat
when's the due date for the Nile Tower invoice?
Meeting
Let's move the due date to the 15th to match their payment cycle.
dont: The last day of the payment is passed.
doo: The invoice is past its due date.

words.def: a short general description of something, without all the details.
words.book: Here's a quick overview of what's new: ___.
uses: Email
Below is a quick overview of the new maintenance packages.
Chat
can you send me an overview of the project status?
Meeting
Let me start with a brief overview of the proposal.
dont: I will give you an idea general about the project.
doo: Let me give you a quick overview of the project.

upgrade.plain: You didn't pay the invoice until now.
upgrade.ar: إنت لسه مادفعتش الفاتورة لحد دلوقتي
pro: You didn't pay until now, please pay.
This is a gentle reminder that invoice 1045 remains unpaid.
Why you didn't pay the invoice?
upgrade.why: في التحصيل خليك مؤدب: ‎gentle reminder‎ و ‎remains unpaid‎ بدل اللوم.

pro: Please kindly arrange for the payment at your earliest convenience.
Please transfer the money quickly quickly.
upgrade.why: ‎arrange for the payment‎ أرقى وأقل حدة من ‎transfer the money quickly‎.

upgrade.plain: I want to make a meeting with you.
pro: I want to do a meeting with you.
I'd like to request a meeting with you to discuss the renewal.
upgrade.why: بنقول ‎request / schedule a meeting‎ مش ‎make a meeting‎.

upgrade.plain: Which day is good for you?
pro: Which day is comfortable for you?
Please let me know which option works best for you.
upgrade.why: ‎comfortable‎ للكراسي مش للمواعيد؛ قول ‎works best for you‎.

upgrade.plain: We have new good news to tell you.
upgrade.ar: عندنا أخبار حلوة جديدة عايزين نقولها لك
pro: We have new good news to tell you.
We're excited to announce the launch of our new lithium battery range.
upgrade.why: في الإعلانات ابدأ بـ ‎We're excited to announce …‎.

upgrade.plain: Thank you for dealing with us.
pro: Thank you for dealing with us.
upgrade.why: ‎dealing with‎ ترجمة حرفية؛ الإنجليزي بيقول ‎Thank you for your business‎.
